description: Forty English questions covering twenty answer intents, authored from the frozen corpus before model retrieval. Each intent has a direct and a paraphrased query. Patterns identify candidate answer-bearing chunks; explicit group judgments may supplement them after pooled review. This is a small diagnostic set, not an independent general benchmark.

intents.answer: Set repository-local project-memory.id to distinguish repositories with the same directory name.
queries: How do I set project-memory.id for repositories with the same folder name?
Two unrelated checkouts have identical directory names. How can I stop their memories from being mixed together?

intents.answer: Shared HTTP calls must pass an absolute existing workdir, or supply exactly one valid MCP root.
queries: What workdir does the shared HTTP MCP server require?
Several coding sessions use one memory service. How does each request tell it which checkout the question belongs to?

intents.answer: Synchronization runs on client startup, periodically while active, and once after the last client closes.
queries: When does sync_memory.py synchronize while Claude or Codex is running and after the last client closes?
If I close all my coding assistants immediately after changing a document, will those last edits still reach memory?

intents.answer: Incremental imports skip unchanged files, replace changed chunks, and remove chunks for deleted files.
queries: How does incremental import handle unchanged, edited and deleted Markdown files?
Will another document scan embed everything again, and do removed documents remain searchable?

intents.answer: Changing EMBEDDING_MODEL requires rebuilding/re-embedding the stored index.
queries: What must I do after changing EMBEDDING_MODEL?
Can I replace the text encoder and keep searching the vectors that were generated by the previous one?

intents.answer: A revision check aborts a rebuild if writes occur during staging; pause writers and retry.
queries: What happens if a note is saved while migrate_memory.py --rebuild stages a new generation?
How does rebuilding memory avoid losing a new note that arrives halfway through the operation?

intents.answer: Disable AOF for the initial RDB restore because existing AOF data takes precedence, then re-enable it.
queries: Why must AOF be disabled when restoring dump.rdb?
I copied a database snapshot into a fresh instance, but the append-only log can override it. What is the proper restore order?

intents.answer: A pending stdin pipe read blocks scipy/Fortran inspection during model import; use a private transport pipe and PeekNamedPipe, and DEVNULL for subprocesses.
queries: Why does model loading deadlock on Windows with an MCP stdin pipe?
Why can the memory server finish its handshake yet hang forever when the embedding runtime starts on Windows?

intents.answer: updated_at is the time content was written to Redis; source_modified_at is the imported file modification time. Rebuilds preserve these.
queries: What is the difference between updated_at and source_modified_at, and does a rebuild change them?
Does the date shown on a memory result describe when the original file changed or when it was imported?

intents.answer: Search starts with thirty candidates, folds identical content and note chunks, and expands until it has three distinct results or exhausts candidates.
queries: How does search expand its 30 nearest candidates to return three distinct results?
Multiple worktrees contain the same documentation. What stops all three memory hits from being copies of one paragraph?

intents.answer: The current ordinary footprint trail has a 24-slot ring, fades over five to six metres of cumulative travel, and stationary prints fade between twelve and twenty action-time seconds.
queries: What are the current Footprints.h trail distance, pool size and stationary expiry?
How long should my character's footprints remain if I keep walking, and what happens if I stand still?

intents.answer: Repeated ground fitting of footprints caused a reproducible CPU slowdown; caching prints and terrain sampling fixed that bottleneck, while intermittent GPU stalls remain separate.
queries: What caused the progressive slowdown near the monastery and how was footprint terrain sampling fixed?
Why did the game gradually get slower as I walked farther, and which repeated calculation was eliminated?

intents.answer: Stillness prepares according to Breath and then decelerates smoothly over 0.60 seconds from world scale 1 to 0.05, even at full Breath.
queries: Does full Breath make Stillness instant, or does the 0.60 second deceleration still apply?
When my energy is full and I start concentrating, does the world freeze immediately or ease into slow motion?

intents.answer: Environmental ambience slows to thirty percent with a hollow stereo return; breath and heartbeat retain natural timing.
queries: What playback rate does Stillness use for ambience, breathing and heartbeat?
When the world slows down, should birds and water stretch in pitch while the character's breathing remains natural?

intents.answer: Quality preset changes made with F2 are saved and applied on restart, not live.
queries: Do F2 quality preset changes apply live or after a restart?
I changed the graphics settings but the scene still looks the same. When should the new settings take effect?

intents.answer: Grass, foliage, particles and character attachments share a coherent wind field and gust timing, with different response strengths.
queries: How do grass, particles and character hair share the same wind and gust timing?
What keeps the vegetation and the monk's loose hair reacting to the same breeze rather than moving independently?

intents.answer: Repeated polish_pixal.forearm_twist passes can drift skin weights; make that operation idempotent before repeated hero rebuilds.
queries: What is the unresolved idempotence problem in polish_pixal.forearm_twist?
Why should we avoid repeatedly rebuilding the selected character before fixing the arm-weight processing?

intents.answer: The default hero is the selected Pixal3D Mountain Pilgrim with dark mane/beard, ochre tunic and clay-red wrap, not the old procedural hooded hero.
queries: Which Pixal3D Mountain Pilgrim character is selected as the default hero?
Which character appearance must we preserve instead of going back to the older hooded version?

intents.answer: Only authored pine/bypass route clues get the warm Stillness highlight; ordinary player footprints keep natural soil shading.
queries: Do ordinary player footprints get the same warm Stillness highlight as authored pine and bypass clues?
Should every mark I leave on the ground glow while concentrating, or only the tracks that reveal an alternate route?

intents.answer: Pixal3D is preferred for trees, shrubs and the chosen character; TRELLIS.2 is used for architecture and rigid props; small mass-instanced vegetation stays cards or procedural.
queries: When should asset generation use Pixal3D versus TRELLIS.2?
Which generator should make our trees and bushes, and which should make buildings and solid scenery?
